public_rationale: Stockfish 12 made neural position evaluation the default on September 2, 2020, and combined it with alpha-beta search [e1]. Stockfish 17.1's March 30, 2025 documentation and source code show continued neural-network use and explicit move search [e2, e3]. These records support the claimed neural-plus-symbolic architecture over several years before June 2025 [e1, e2, e3]. A specialist observer's January 5, 2025 report records Stockfish winning the TCEC Season 27 superfinal, supporting its description as a leading chess engine [e4].
limitations: The architectural evidence supports the concrete combination of neural evaluation and explicit chess search; it does not establish broader claims about world models [e1, e2, e3].
The championship result comes from a specialist secondary account and does not establish superiority in every competition [e4].

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Stockfish, the leading chess AI, has been a neurosymbolic hybrid for several years.

statement.excerpt: In fact, the leading chess AI, Stockfish, has for the last several years been a neurosymbolic hybrid model, using a neural network to evaluate moves, but a symbolic infrastructure to search moves
statement.document_title: Generative AI’s crippling and widespread failure to induce robust models of the world

from_speaker: using a neural network to evaluate moves
a symbolic infrastructure to search moves
our_interpretation: Neurosymbolic hybrid is read in the concrete sense Marcus immediately supplies: neural evaluation combined with explicit chess-state search.
Evaluating moves includes evaluating the resulting board positions during search.
Leading means a top competitive chess engine, supported by major championship performance; it does not require winning every game or every event.

Several years is read as a multiyear period before June 2025. The target window begins in 2020 to encompass that recent history; this is not a claim that the architecture existed throughout every day of 2020.
criteria.support_condition: Dated releases and source code establish neural evaluation combined with explicit chess search over several years before the post, and competitive results establish leading status.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Dated records show that the neural-plus-symbolic architecture was absent or only recently adopted, or competitive evidence makes the description of Stockfish as a leading engine untenable.

evidence.explanation: Stockfish 12 made neural evaluation the default in September 2020. The following paragraph explains that position evaluations feed alpha-beta search, directly establishing the claimed architectural combination several years before the post.
The version-pinned README confirms continued neural-network use in Stockfish 17.1. Its release date is established by the official announcement considered above.
The implementation searches explicit board positions and moves using alpha and beta bounds, with separate static evaluation. This supports the symbolic-search component of Marcus's description.
